A kids yoga class all about kindness: partner poses, games & a craft to share. Ages 4-6. Kindrid Kava, Old Brooklyn.

About this Event

The Yoga Club : Old Brooklyn Oct 17Kindness Crew is a playful yoga class for our littlest yogis, part of The Yoga Club City Tour. We'll talk about what kindness looks like, then practice it with partner poses, cooperative games, and kindness cards to make and share.
Date & Location: Saturday, October 17 | Kindrid Kava (Old Brooklyn)
Ages: 4-6 | 45 minutes
What kids will learn: Simple breathing tools and mindfulness practices they can use anywhere to stay calm, focused, and confident, plus how small acts of kindness make everyone around them feel good.
What kids will do:
Start with breathwork and a gentle yoga warm-upTalk together about kindness Partner poses and gamesDecorate a Dino craftWind down with a mindfulness activity and relaxationWhat to bring: Comfy clothes and a water bottle. Mats and all materials are provided.
